description: Fix verified bugs and practical issues from the AUDIT.md review

userStories.title: Treat only explicit done status as complete for blocker resolution
userStories.description: As an operator, I want blocker resolution to require an explicit done status so that tickets with missing, claimed, or in-progress statuses are not treated as completed.
acceptanceCriteria: findReadyTickets builds doneNums from tickets with status === 'done' instead of status !== 'ready-for-agent'
simulateWaves uses the same done-only logic for its doneNums set
detectDeadlocks uses the same done-only logic for its initial doneNums set
A ticket with status '' (no Status line) does not unblock dependents
A ticket with status 'claimed' or 'resolved' does not unblock dependents
A ticket with status 'done' still unblocks dependents
Tests cover empty-status, claimed, resolved, and done scenarios
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Three functions in orchestrator.ts share the same inverted logic: findReadyTickets (line 106), simulateWaves (line 169), detectDeadlocks (line 196). All must change from !== 'ready-for-agent' to === 'done'.

userStories.title: Handle existing branches when re-creating worktrees
userStories.description: As an operator re-running after a failed ticket, I want createWorktree to handle pre-existing branches so that the CLI does not crash.
acceptanceCriteria: createWorktree detects an existing branch and deletes it (git branch -D) before creating the worktree, or reuses the existing worktree if it is still present
If a worktree already exists at the target path, it is removed (git worktree remove) before re-creating
runWavesIsolated wraps worktree creation so a single ticket failure is reported per-ticket instead of crashing the entire Promise.all
Tests cover the re-run scenario where a branch from a prior failed run already exists
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: worktree.ts line 50: git worktree add -b fails when the branch exists. Check for existing branch/worktree first, or catch the error and clean up.

userStories.title: Handle gitignored progress path in commitProgress
userStories.description: As an operator with .scratch/ in .gitignore, I want the CLI to handle progress commits gracefully instead of crashing.
acceptanceCriteria: commitProgress uses git add --force so that gitignored paths are still staged
Alternatively, runWavesIsolated catches commitProgress errors and logs a warning instead of crashing
A run with .scratch/ in .gitignore completes without throwing
Tests cover the gitignored-path scenario
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: progress.ts line 108: git add <path> fails on gitignored paths. Either use git add --force or wrap calls in try/catch with a warning.

userStories.title: Add permission flags to provider argument maps
userStories.description: As a user running nightralph claude, I want the spawned agent to have write permissions so that tickets can actually be implemented.
acceptanceCriteria: claude provider args include a permission flag that allows file writes (e.g. --dangerously-skip-permissions)
codex provider args include a sandbox flag that allows workspace writes (e.g. --full-auto)
The README documents the default flags applied for each provider
Tests verify the updated argument lists for both providers
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: orchestrator.ts lines 225-228: PROVIDER_ARGS maps claude to ['--print'] and codex to ['exec'] with no permission flags. Add appropriate flags for non-interactive file-writing operation.

userStories.title: Clean up worktrees for failed and skipped tickets
userStories.description: As an operator, I want worktrees to be cleaned up after failed or skipped tickets so that they do not accumulate as sibling directories.
acceptanceCriteria: After a ticket's agent exits non-zero, its worktree is removed
After mergeWave stops (stoppedAt), remaining worktrees for un-merged branches are removed
Worktree removal errors are caught and logged, not thrown
Tests verify cleanup occurs on failure and stop scenarios
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: orchestrator.ts: worktrees are only removed on merged (line 722) and recovered (line 773) paths. Add cleanup after the failed-agent block (line 683) and after the stoppedAt break (line 799).

userStories.title: Preserve progress file when resuming a partial run
userStories.description: As an operator resuming after a partial run, I want the progress file to reflect prior ticket completions so that history is not lost.
acceptanceCriteria: runWavesIsolated reads an existing progress.md before calling generateProgress
If the file exists, completed tickets (done: true) in the existing data are carried forward into the new progress object
If no progress file exists, behavior is unchanged (fresh generation)
Tests cover resume with a pre-existing progress file
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: orchestrator.ts line 570: generateProgress always creates fresh all-unchecked data. Add a readProgress helper in progress.ts that parses an existing file and merges completed state.

userStories.title: Remove unreachable hasNewCommits check in runWaves
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want dead code removed so that the non-isolated execution path is correct and readable.
acceptanceCriteria: The hasNewCommits guard in runWaves (the non-isolated path) is removed or replaced with logic that works outside a git repo
The baseSha variable and its git rev-parse call are removed if no longer used
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: orchestrator.ts lines 471-476 and 510-519: runWaves only runs outside a git repo, so repoRoot is always null, making the hasNewCommits check unreachable. Remove the dead branch.

userStories.title: Fix cosmetic issues: completedAt stamp and npm package contents
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want checkTicket to not stamp completedAt on failed tickets and test files excluded from the npm package.
acceptanceCriteria: checkTicket only sets completedAt when the ticket is marked done (result.done is true or defaults to true)
package.json includes a files field that excludes dist/test/ from the published package
npm pack --dry-run does not list any dist/test/ files
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: progress.ts line 90: completedAt is set unconditionally. Guard with if (result.done !== false). package.json: add a files field like ["dist/**", "!dist/test"].

userStories.title: Fix doc inconsistencies in AGENTS.md and README
userStories.description: As a user reading the docs, I want AGENTS.md and README to match the actual code behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: AGENTS.md says Node >= 24 instead of Node >= 18
README explains that success requires exit 0, new commits, and a clean worktree (not just exit 0)
README provider examples mention the permission flags applied by default
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: AGENTS.md line 'Node >= 18' should match package.json engines '>=24'. README success description needs the full set of checks. Update after US-004 lands so flag docs are accurate.
